disabled.$description: Surface colour for disabled or inactive UI.

default.$description: The secondary action (a subtle fill), at rest.

hover.$description: The secondary action (a subtle fill), hovered.

pressed.$description: The secondary action (a subtle fill), pressed.

interactive.$description: Border of a control (input, select, checkbox, outline button), at least 3:1 against the surface it sits on.

onInteractive.$description: Text and icons on the primary interactive surface (buttons and selected controls).

onDestructive.$description: Text and icons on the destructive action.

solid.$description: Solid info fill, for emphasis (a solid badge or banner).

control.$description: Corner radius of a control at the default size: the brand recipe's radius.

small.$description: Corner radius of a small control: the brand radius less 2px.

large.$description: Corner radius of a large control: the brand radius plus 2px.

card.$description: Corner radius of a card or panel: twice the brand radius.

pill.$description: Fully rounded ends, for badges and pills.
